title: EDI Lens anonymise rules
description: Which values EDI Lens: Anonymise Message and Anonymise Folder replace, and how.

profiles.description: Built-in rule sets to use. When this list is present it replaces the setting ediLens.anonymise.profiles; an empty list switches the built-in rules off.

rules.description: Your own rules. They come before the built-in profiles: the first rule that covers a value decides.

path.description: The value to replace: PID-5 (the whole element), PID-3.1 (one component), NM1[IL]-3 or NAD[BY]-3.1 (only in segments with that qualifier).

enumDescriptions: Letters become X and digits become 9; the length stays.
Letters and digits are replaced by other letters and digits; the same original always gives the same result; the length stays.
Like pseudonym, but the result reads like a name.
The date is moved by a number of days that is the same for the whole run, so the order of dates is kept.
The value is left as it is (use it to switch a built-in rule off for one path).
The value is emptied. This is the only action that changes the length of a value.
